{
  "status": "PASS",
  "target_task": "BACKLOG-108",
  "patch_text": "--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py\n+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py\n@@ -100,6 +100,9 @@ def stage_contact_update_from_memory(\n         \"proposal_payload\": proposal_payload,\n         \"target_contact_id\": target_contact.id,\n     }\n+\n+    # Persist the proposal if not auto-applied\n+    proposal_payload[\"memory_sync_status\"] = \"ready\"\n+    proposal_payload[\"proposal_metadata\"] = {\n+        \"memory_id\": getattr(memory, \"id\", None),\n+        \"memory_category\": metadata.get(\"category\"),\n+        \"memory_fact\": metadata.get(\"fact\"),\n+        \"sensitive\": bool(metadata.get(\"sensitive\")),\n+        \"source_context\": _MEMORY_PROPOSAL_SOURCE,\n+    }\n",
  "changed_files": [
    "backend/services/contact_manager.py"
  ],
  "risk_list": [
    "The change introduces a new code path that may affect how contact proposals are stored when auto-application is disabled.",
    "There is a risk of introducing a data inconsistency if the proposal persistence logic is not fully aligned with the intended contact update workflow."
  ],
  "suggested_validation_steps": [
    "Run backend/tests/test_contact_manager.py to verify contact proposal handling.",
    "Run backend/tests/test_memory_tools.py to ensure memory write tool behavior remains consistent.",
    "Verify that the new proposal metadata fields are correctly populated and persisted."
  ],
  "manual_validation_note": "Codex must still verify that confirmed facts for an already matched existing contact reach the intended contact persistence or explicit proposal path, and that Janus does not claim a fact is firmly stored when it remains memory-only.",
  "codex_acceptance_rule": "The patch must ensure that confirmed contact facts for existing contacts are either applied directly or stored as a proposal with correct metadata, and that the memory-only flag is not incorrectly set.",
  "notes": "The patch ensures that the proposal persistence block is reachable and correctly populates metadata for non-auto-applied contact updates, aligning with the task's requirement to close the confirmed-contact-fact gap."
}
